_comment: The abuse control for /api/solana, in the shape the Cloudflare Rulesets API accepts. Prose, plan constraints, the reason for the threshold and the verification procedure are in site/README.md; this file and that one must be changed together. Apply to the http_ratelimit phase entrypoint ruleset of the erashot.app zone: PUT /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/phases/http_ratelimit/entrypoint with {"rules": [rule]}.
_applied_note: Raised from 60 to 120 on 2026-09-25 (site/README.md); the rule applied on 2026-09-12 still caps at 60 until this file is applied again.

_constraints.note: cf.colo.id is mandatory and is added implicitly by Cloudflare; it is listed here because the API expects it and it must never appear in the rule expression.

_not_covered: *.pages.dev preview deployments are outside the erashot.app zone and inherit no rule; keep SOLANA_RPC_URL bound to Production only.
A distributed caller spread across many IPs is not bounded by a per-IP counter.
